description: Corrected structural map of UNC119A Gly22 vs experimentally observed region
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
af = requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q13432", timeout=90).json()[0]
pdb = requests.get(af["pdbUrl"], timeout=120).text
rows=[{"resi":int(l[22:26]),"plddt":float(l[60:66])} for l in pdb.splitlines()
      if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"]
d=pd.DataFrame(rows)
g22=d.loc[d.resi==22,"plddt"].values[0]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.2))
ax.plot(d.resi, d.plddt, lw=1.5, color="#4C72B0")
ax.axhspan(0,50,color="#C44E52",alpha=0.07); ax.axhspan(90,100,color="#55A868",alpha=0.07)
ax.axvspan(59,237,color="grey",alpha=0.14)
ax.text(148,96,"residues 59-237: the only region with observed density\nin all 9 UNC119A crystal structures (4GOJ, 4GOK, 3GQQ, 3RBQ,\n5L7K, 6H6A, 7UMO, 9GKG, 9NEM)",ha="center",va="top",fontsize=8,color="dimgrey")
ax.axvline(22,color="#C44E52",lw=1.6,ls="--")
ax.annotate(f"Gly22, the reported ICL variant site\npLDDT {g22:.0f} (very low confidence)\nnever resolved experimentally",
            xy=(22,g22), xytext=(52,8), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#C44E52"),
            color="#C44E52", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("UNC119A residue (UniProt Q13432, 240 aa)"); ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT")
ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.set_xlim(1,240)
ax.set_title("The UNC119A site implicated in immunodeficiency 13 sits in an intrinsically disordered N-terminal arm")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("mean pLDDT 1-50: %.1f | 59-237: %.1f | %% of 1-50 below 50: %.0f%%" %
      (d[d.resi<=50].plddt.mean(), d[(d.resi>=59)&(d.resi<=237)].plddt.mean(), 100*d[d.resi<=50].plddt.lt(50).mean()))
